inventoryRule: This is reviewed data, not an executable schema or a DAG/ledger mirror. Each outcome and consumer has one implementation owner; every displaced route has one production-capable deletion/rejection owner. UAP0-AC-R1 validates coverage and bindings. Imported routes retain their original owner/path; their prerequisite owner need not be a successor of LRA0.

displacedRoutes.route: Native macro_code_actions, component_code_actions, suggest_matching_props and event_type_hint_actions construct transport-native CodeActionOrCommand through action_utils::{make_code_action,make_insert_action}, bypassing the CodeAction/FileEdit model
displacedRoutes.disposition: Migrate the native action producers onto the same qualified alternatives/applicability/safety model as ActionEngine, preserving their existing fixture edits. ACT1-AC2 and ACT1-AC3 require atomic multi-file alternatives and whole-alternative refusal for irreversible maps. This action-model cutover does not own LSO8's direct edit-builder retirement.

displacedRoutes.route: action_utils::{make_insert_action,make_insert_edit,make_replace_edit} materialize WorkspaceEdit/TextEdit with version: None. macro_code_actions uses make_insert_action, which inlines edit construction without calling the other two helpers. Component actions use make_insert_edit directly and through ChildComponentContext::{make_insert_at_macros,make_insert_into_macro} in cross_file.rs; event_type_hint_actions uses make_replace_edit
displacedRoutes.disposition: Delete or structurally reject semantic producers' direct WorkspaceEdit/TextEdit construction, including the inline builder in make_insert_action and every caller of all three shared builders. Normalize authored intents with exact current/foreign source and mapping preconditions through the sole transaction validator; retain only thin transport projection after validation. Placeholder URI replacement and live-content anchor checks do not discharge transaction validation. ACT1 separately migrates native action envelopes; its model cutover cannot discharge this retirement.

displacedRoutes.route: organize_imports_actions constructs transport-native CodeActionOrCommand inline for source.organizeImports, bypassing ActionEngine, CodeAction/FileEdit and action_utils action wrappers
displacedRoutes.disposition: Migrate LSP-native unused-import removal onto qualified alternatives with independent applicability and safety, preserving full-import deletion and partial-specifier edits on existing fixtures. The source.organizeImports-only request must consume this model even when no quickfix or ActionEngine route runs. LSO8 separately retires the inline raw edit builder; model migration cannot discharge transaction validation.

displacedRoutes.route: organize_imports_actions constructs TextEdit deletion/replacement ranges and an inline WorkspaceEdit with version: None, without make_insert_action, make_insert_edit or make_replace_edit
displacedRoutes.disposition: Delete or structurally reject this independent semantic fix edit-construction route. Express unused-import deletion and specifier replacement as authored intents validated against exact source and map basis by the sole transaction engine, then project validated edits to LSP. Placeholder URI replacement does not validate the basis. Retiring the three action_utils builders leaves this route intact; ACT1 separately owns its action envelope.

displacedRoutes.route: extract_component_action constructs transport-native CodeActionOrCommand inline for refactor.extract, bypassing ActionEngine, CodeAction/FileEdit and action_utils action wrappers
displacedRoutes.disposition: Migrate LSP-native extract-to-component onto qualified alternatives with independent applicability and safety. The refactor.extract-only request must consume this model even when no quickfix or ActionEngine route runs. Current controls pin the offer, kind and refusals, not the edit bytes, so ACT1 pins the selection replacement, import insertion and new-file content before migrating. ACT1-AC2 applies to this multi-file alternative. LSO8 separately retires the inline edit construction; RFX3 separately replaces the text-slice extraction body. No one of these discharges another's obligation.

displacedRoutes.route: extract_component_action constructs replacement and import TextEdits, a CreateFile operation, a new-file edit and an inline WorkspaceEdit with version: None from a raw source slice. Its signature takes no source or map revision and it uses none of make_insert_action, make_insert_edit or make_replace_edit
displacedRoutes.disposition: Delete or structurally reject this independent semantic edit-construction route. Express the selection replacement, import insertion and file creation as authored intents validated against exact source and map basis by the sole transaction engine, rejecting the whole alternative across all files on a stale or unmappable basis, then project validated edits to LSP. The foreground binding that stamps the request's document version onto the finished edit, its withholding of resource operations from clients without documentChanges and its refusal of a create target that appeared before settlement are request-validity rules; they do not validate the source and map basis the edits were built from. Retiring the three action_utils builders leaves this route intact; ACT1 separately owns its action envelope.

displacedRoutes.route: merge_code_actions constructs transport-native CodeActionOrCommand inline for provider quickfixes, bypassing ActionEngine, CodeAction/FileEdit and action_utils action wrappers
displacedRoutes.disposition: Carry provider quickfixes as qualified alternatives with external provenance and independent applicability and safety, preserving the mapped edits and fail-closed drops the merge and real-provider tests pin. The action is not machine-applicable without ACT2 verification. LSO8 separately owns the edit construction; model migration cannot discharge transaction validation.

displacedRoutes.route: merge_code_actions builds per-URI TextEdits and an inline WorkspaceEdit from mapped provider edits, with its own preamble-import re-anchoring, without any action_utils edit builder
displacedRoutes.disposition: Delete or structurally reject this edit-construction route. Validate mapped provider edits against the exact source, mapper and snapshot of each target file through the sole transaction engine, retire the code-action import re-anchor in favour of the shared insertion anchor, and project validated edits to LSP. Strict mapping and post-await surface revalidation do not supply a transaction basis. ACT1 separately owns the action envelope.

codeActionRouteAudit.rule: Every producer the handler calls for a code-action answer. A direct producer builds its own transport action outside ActionEngine, so it binds one ACT1 model row and one LSO8 edit row. A bridged producer reaches ActionEngine and binds the shared engine and model rows.
